Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite candidate for Feudal Lord Simulator, southern England 1300–1450, historical profile S_England_1300_1450_v1, art bible AB_2026-09-19_v1.
Four attached PROJECT-OWNED images are reference inputs only: Image 1 grass.png sets the subdued olive grass palette; Image 2 forest_floor.png sets the warm dark leaf-litter earth; Image 3 packed_earth_road.png sets the muted pale warm compacted earth; Image 4 wheat_farm_ripe-v4.png sets the hand-painted isometric sprite finish. Use ALL four to keep a coherent game palette. Do not reproduce the wheat crop unless requested (none is requested here).
Prioritize final display readability: source tile 128×64 pixels displays as 64×32 CSS pixels at zoom 1 and 38.4×19.2 at zoom .6. Draw BIG SIMPLE COHERENT forms at the stated asset dimensions. Do not make a highly detailed large painting. No tiny noisy marks. Main tufts, rut ridges and silhouette changes must remain several screen pixels wide at .6 zoom.
Genuine transparent PNG alpha, no white or black backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image. Soft upper-left light but no directional cast shadow. Crisp painterly edges, no Gaussian blur, no bloom, no smeared shading, no photographic noise. No text, labels, watermark, grid, raised tile base, buildings, people, animals, modern objects, flowers, fantasy plants. No outside artworks.
ASSET: earth road repeating strip. Exact requested final canvas 512×64px, perfectly overhead TOP-DOWN, no isometric tilt and no perspective. Horizontal left-to-right road direction. Road surface must reach the LEFT and RIGHT canvas edges: USER EXPLICITLY EXEMPTED the left/right 8px padding for this road only. Leave rows 0..7 and 56..63 fully transparent. Between these blank rows and the central road, about 8px of irregular sparse earth-and-grass coverage creates alpha edge transition; this is material breakup, NOT blurry fog. The central flat compacted earth is warm gray-brown matching packed_earth_road.png. TWO understated, readable horizontal wagon wheel ruts, not modern tire tracks, about 6–8px wide at source scale, separated by a quiet crown. A few very small low-contrast stones, a few short olive grass blades at the outer long edges. Leftmost and rightmost 16px must form matching continuation bands so three exact copies placed edge-to-edge are seamless: rut heights, alpha profile, earth value and brush shapes continue smoothly. Avoid any unique focal stone or strong periodic motif. Flat strip only; no scene, no decorative frame.
